missions.title: Recruit
missions.desc: Weeks before the Sky Patrol ever heard of them, the Sky Rebellion takes in a new member.

lines.t: The Sky Rebellion's hideout. Fallen Skylanders, banished by the Royals - and one newcomer.
This one joins us. Don't question it.
lines.group: These ones join us. Don't question it.

lines.t: A new fallen one? Good. More hands for the Capital.
lines.ground: ...Not even a Skylander. Why is the leader letting them in?

lines.t: Hm? New guy? ...zzz.
lines.ground: Father's letting a human join? ...Weird. Whatever. ...zzz.

lines.t: Don't get comfortable. You're the weakest one here now. Not me.
lines.ground: A human? Father must see something in you. I don't.

lines.t: (Happy) Ooh, are they bringing us a vessel? Persephone and I have been waiting forever!
Me first, Ava. ...Hi, new person. Be nice to us demons, okay?
...Okay.
Logan. Keita. Take the newcomer to the Capital. We finish taking it today.
lines.group: Logan. Keita. Take the newcomers to the Capital. We finish taking it today.

missions.title: The Capital Falls
missions.desc: Help Logan and Keita take full control of the Royal Capital.

steps.obj: Take the Royal Capital: beat the knights loyal to the Royals
The palace guard pours out of both wings - Logan and Keita take one

lines.t: (Confident) Full control of the Royal Capital. Keita, you can thank me.
I helped from the other side of the Capital.
You were SLEEPING the whole time! {You} did more than you.
lines.group: You were SLEEPING the whole time! The new ones did more than you.

lines.t: ...He snores.
Hehe. I like this one.

missions.title: Portal Practice
missions.desc: Kill shows you Aurora's room and portal tech - by throwing you into it.

lines.t: Aurora's rooms. A whole fight here and nobody in the city sees a thing. Watch.
First test - survive what I send through.
...Not bad. Just call me Kill for now. The leader's the only one who knows my real name.

missions.title: A New Captain
missions.desc: Ava is gone. The hideout is burned. Lexy - Persephone - walks in.

lines.t: Leader... they killed Ava. And the SP knows a hideout. We have to burn it.
Ava was weak. You never should have let her take a Royal.
...Was what I heard about Ava true?
You fused with your demon. Like me. You're captain now, Persephone.
Captain?! But I thought I was-
Shut it. Now - the Sky Patrol is coming. Hold them off while we burn this place.

steps.obj: Hold off the Sky Patrol's raid while the hideout burns

lines.t: Thanks for watching my back. Ava would've liked you.
lines.sky: Thanks for watching my back. A real Skylander, too. Ava would've liked you.

missions.title: Betrayal
missions.desc: "Betraying the Government is our next step to greatness."

lines.t: We partnered with the Government long enough. They sold us out the day they armed Aurora.
The newcomer leads the first strike. Prove me right.
lines.group: The newcomers lead the first strike. Prove me right.

lines.t: Father never says that. ...Don't mess it up.
lines.ground: Father trusts a human with this? ...Okay. Don't mess it up.

lines.t: Good. The Government will remember the Sky Rebellion. And you.
Rhalix still owes me a battle. Not yet. ...You've earned your place here.
